title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theatre on 1971-02-19

ai_review.summary: Clear matrix mix captures a high‑energy show with the debut Bird Song, a monster Good Lovin' jam and classic China Rider.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this matrix recording for its crisp vocals and balanced crowd ambience, calling it an upgrade over earlier audience tapes. The performance is described as smoking hot—highlighting Truckin', Easy Wind, a 20‑minute Good Lovin', the first Bird Song and a spirited China Rider—while the crowd’s energy feeds the band throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for both musical performance (standout jams, debut Bird Song) and recording clarity; weighted rating favors strong show quality with good matrix sound.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and crisp vocals/instruments with a well‑balanced crowd mix; not perfect but considered the best available version of this show by several reviewers.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Begins with a brief tuning intro then launches into full‑steam set; crowd energy builds and sustains, feeding the band through long jams and song transitions.
